title: The headless edit guard misses an item path in another case, an item under a worktree prefix, and a duplicate gate id readers take first
goal: kb_hook.headless_guard matches item, settings and guard paths case-insensitively after stripping every .claude/worktrees/<name>/ prefix, and denies a write whose gates hold a duplicate id; bl_check refuses an item with a duplicate gate id, so a prepended {id: start, answer: approve, by: operator} neither passes the guard nor the check; planted-failure tests cover kb/_self/BACKLOG/x.json, a nested worktree item path and a duplicate start gate (tests named headless_guard_case_dup_worktree); found by the SP-zihqagoi re-review
